title: "According to the loaded plugin descriptions the class ... does not exist" in ROS 2 pluginlib: export call, base package, name vs type and the other load errors, measured
excerpt: 15 plugin packages, most with one mistake, loaded with pluginlib on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical: which mistakes give "does not exist", "no factory exists for it", "Could not find library" and the dlopen undefined symbol error, how to read "Declared types are", and when a re-source is needed.
